serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: N-no, I didn’t learn anything.
Shanice: Yeah, no surprise there.
You: Excuse me?
Shanice: Come on, it’s not like me or Priestbot expected you to actually bring any good info.
You: Are you serious?! Why?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Don’t be upset. Me and Shanice are doing our best to research these groups, but so far we were unlucky. They are very secretive. 
Shanice: Just sit tight and wait for any new development. Worst thing you could do is to go around and ask strangers about them on your own. You are the one who has an advanced sexbot they are after.
You: Y-yeah, you are right…
Good thing I didn’t tell them about Big Daddy. They would probably be mad that I tried to gather info on my own.
